title: Wishing for better organizational grouping system….
body: Good recipe app. Simple, concise, straight forward, graphically easy to use, But, perhaps I missed something when it came to grouping like recipes into categories, thus only 4 stars. I prefer my recipes grouped in categories, i.e. all cookies together, one pan dinners, breakfasts, etc., naming categories for quick personal reference. For example if I want chicken dinner, I want favorite chicken recipes in one place, so I don’t have to flick through other unrelated items. Organizing recipes this way would make MY RECIPE BOX superior to others because it is simple, easy to use without the froufrou and unnecessary bells and whistles of other apps.

title: Free, took the job of 3 apps :)

From there I went to Reddit for alternatives, found this one, and I’ve been happily emptying out my Pinterest recipe boards into it for literal hours. Since it has a calendar (for meal planning) and a grocery button in addition to the recipe storage, I was able to delete 3 apps that did all this separately. Since it’s free, there’s ads after almost every recipe transfer, but they’re short, and I don’t mind them. Like I said above, I spent hours transferring recipes and wasn’t bothered by the ads at all. 10/10 app, would download again :)
